messages.author: Hector A. Baldoni
messages.body:
Dear amber users
To respond to positive comments of a reviewer, I would like if any amber
user can suggest me how to analyze hydrophobic interactions in a
ligand-receptor complex using cpptraj or some other free available
software.
Thank you for your kind cooperation,
Hector
--
